display_long_description:
Authenticus XRP transforms how you experience unbuilt properties. Designed for homeowners, architects, developers, and sales professionals, this immersive app lets you step inside a range of stunning home designs—long before construction begins.

Explore detailed 3D models and floor plans in fully interactive, walkable environments. Move through spaces at your own pace, switch to dollhouse views for an overhead perspective, and get a true feel for flow, scale, and design. With built-in Augmented Reality features, you can even place a house design on your real-world site to see how it fits into the landscape.

Whether you're making design decisions, collaborating with clients, or simply exploring ideas, Authenticus XRP gives you the power to visualise and share every detail—right from your Meta Quest headset.

Key Features:
• Walk through immersive, high-quality home designs
• View in dollhouse or first-person mode
• Place models on real sites with Augmented Reality
• Share and present designs for easy collaboration
• Access your projects anytime, from anywhere

Authenticus XRP is the future of property visualisation—realistic, accessible, and built to bring your ideas to life.
